title: Charity table tennis tournament – “The Kindness Cup”
body_html:
On 16 March, at the TOP CUP Academy sports complex (12A Bucuriei St., Chișinău), the Hospice Angelus Moldova Foundation, with the support of ATTP, partners and sponsors, held the charity table tennis tournament “The Kindness Cup”.

This tournament of open hearts has already become a tradition. Its aim is to support children with life-threatening illnesses, and to that end every table tennis fan was invited to take part by forming one or more teams, thereby supporting the cause of children with the most severe diagnoses.

All the donations collected were passed in full to the Hospice Angelus Moldova Foundation to provide free, high-quality palliative care for children

We sincerely thank everyone who took part in the Kindness Cup charity tournament, giving not only money but also their time for a great shared goal — helping children with disabilities.

We are also glad that sport and charity go hand in hand: by helping children in need, together we also promote a healthy lifestyle.


Thank you to everyone who helped organise and sponsor the tournament.
